repos_data.description: Free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative for macOS. Native SwiftUI cleaner with app uninstaller, disk analyzer, duplicate finder, Xcode/Docker cleanup, Apple Intelligence and zero telemetry.
Mac Sai: the open-source Mac cleaner, optimizer, and malware scanner. A free, Apple-notarized alternative to CleanMyMac, built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI.
Transparent macOS disk cleaner — groups files by app, moves to Trash (never permanent). SwiftUI + Liquid Glass, built for macOS Tahoe.
🐹 Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac. Free open-source CLI, plus a native Mac app.
Menu bar app that finds and frees the disk space dev build artifacts and caches hog on macOS. Free, open source, notarized, zero telemetry.
Free up your Mac, safely. Clears the cache and junk it piles up on its own. Open source, and everything goes to the Trash, so nothing is ever lost.
TUI macOS cleaner that scans caches/logs, shows sizes/paths, lets you select what to delete before Trash.

Free, open-source application firewall for macOS. Little Snitch alternative with zero telemetry. Native SwiftUI world map, rules manager, DNS over HTTPS, pf-based blocking. Signed, notarized, MIT licensed.
Free macOS menu bar app to visualize and clean developer caches (Xcode, node_modules, CocoaPods, SPM, Docker, pip, Cargo). Reclaim disk space instantly.
Free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS  a native Paste app alternative with color-coded history, pinboards, search & keyboard paste. Signed, notarized, Homebrew.
💻 Sketch Cache Cleaner - Deletes hidden Sketch history files that can take a lot of space on your hard drive and that you would probably never use.
A lightweight, native macOS app uninstaller with drag-and-drop support. Built with Swift and SwiftUI.
